{{nihongo|'''Kuwabara Shrine (Kuwanohon, Takeno Town)'''|桑原神社（竹野町桑野本）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tajima Province]].
